description: Search a library of interactions recorded on live websites (hovers, clicks, focus states, scroll reveals, scroll-linked motion, loops, menu glides), each measured in the browser. Use it when the work is motion: a hover state, a menu, a reveal, an easing curve or a duration to choose, "make this feel like Stripe's", or motion that feels off ("my hover feels janky"). Describe the interaction in q: "a card hover that feels premium", "clip-path reveal", "a 60 ms stagger", "like Stripe's bento hover but softer". Filters narrow it, each strictly: trigger, element, moves, feel, min_ms and max_ms (the main move's length), look, site_kind, and curve (the main move rides close to it). Several values in one filter mean any of them; filters together mean all. With filters, q may be left out: then the results are all the filters keep (up to limit), the closest to curve first when it is given, and kept says how many there are. Each result is one real interaction: its beats as measured (when each starts, how long it runs, its curve), its moving parts, its feel and why it works, its main move's length and curve (measured), its clip (MP4) and a still (JPEG), and links to its page on regards.design and the live page: enough to recreate it. Show the user the ones you use, linked. If your client reads MCP resources, skill://regards-design/interactions/SKILL.md says how to turn one into code. A search with q is one Instant search on the account's plan, shared with search_sections; one with filters alone counts nothing. Both are rate-limited per minute. For static design (layout, type, colour), search_sections.

curve.description: Only interactions whose main move rides close to this curve (within 15% of the way at every moment): a CSS easing ("cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)", "ease-out", "linear", "steps(4)", a result's beats give theirs), a preset (expo-out, ease-out, ease-in-out, spring, linear) or a spring ("spring(170, 18)": stiffness, then damping). With q left out, the closest come first.

element.description: Only these moving things: card, button, link, nav, menu, tabs, hero, heading, text, image, logos, marquee, product-ui, canvas, section, …

feel.description: Only these curve families: ease-out, ease-in-out, ease-in, linear, spring (passes its end and settles back), out-and-back, steps.

look.description: Only these looks of the whole: one accent colour, hairlines, monochrome, line work, pixel grid, glass, 3D render, dashed lines, grain, shallow focus, …

max_ms.description: Only interactions whose main move runs under this long, ms.

min_ms.description: Only interactions whose main move runs at least this long, ms.

moves.description: Only interactions where one of these moves: move (position), scale, rotate, fade, blur, filter, clip (clip-path or mask), color, gradient, background, shadow, radius, size, outline, text (counts, typing, letters), morph (an SVG path), draw (a line drawing itself), drawn (a canvas or WebGL).

q.description: The interaction you want, in any words. May be left out when a filter is given.

site_kind.description: Only interactions from these kinds of site, as the gallery files sites: 'saas', 'ai', 'agency', 'portfolio', 'finance', …

trigger.description: Only these triggers: hover, click, focus, scroll-in (plays once as it scrolls into view), scroll-linked (tied to the scroll position), loop (plays by itself), glide (a highlight gliding along a menu).

name: search_interactions

kept.description: How many interactions in the library every filter keeps (null: no filters).

beats.description: Each beat as measured in the browser: when it starts after the trigger (ms), how long it runs, what moves, how, and its curve.

clip.description: The recording, an MP4 at the size it was recorded.

element.description: What moves: card, button, nav, tabs, hero, …

host.description: The site it was recorded on.

kind.description: What sets it off: hover, click, focus, scroll (plays as it scrolls into view), scrub (tied to the scroll), ambient (a loop).

link.description: Its page on regards.design: the clip, the beats and the parts. Link it when you show the user.

measured.description: What was measured: the property families that move, the curve families, the main move's length (ms) and its curve as CSS ("cubic-bezier(…)", "steps(…)", "linear(…)") or a spring ("spring(stiffness, damping)"; null when it couldn't be read), a stagger, whether it moves by transforms alone, and what draws a canvas.

ms.description: How long the recording runs, ms.

parts.description: The moving parts, and what each does.

picture.description: A still at its peak, a JPEG.

small.description: The recording at 960 px wide, an MP4.

target.description: What it looks like at rest.

url.description: The live page it was recorded on.

title: Search interactions
